    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">补充MySQL官网知识--解锁Online VARCHAR字段扩展与Index的关系</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>大家可以先看本文的结论【即 <strong>4. 总结</strong>】，如有兴趣再顺读。</p>
<h3>1.&nbsp;<strong>Online DDL Support for Column Operations</strong></h3>

<thead>
<tr><th scope="col">Operation</th><th scope="col">In Place</th><th scope="col">Rebuilds Table</th><th scope="col">Permits Concurrent DML</th><th scope="col">Only Modifies Metadata</th></tr>

<tr><th style="text-align: left" scope="row">Adding a column</th>

<h3>2.&nbsp;Extending <code class="literal">VARCHAR</code> column size</h3>
<table summary="Online DDL support for column operations indicating whether the operation is performed in place, rebuilds the table, permits concurrent DML, or only modifies metadata.">
<thead>
<tr><th scope="col">Operation</th><th scope="col">In Place</th><th scope="col">Rebuilds Table</th><th scope="col">Permits Concurrent DML</th><th scope="col">Only Modifies Metadata</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><th scope="row">Extending <code class="literal">VARCHAR</code> column size</th>
<td>Yes</td>
<td>No</td>
<td>Yes</td>
<td>Yes</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>修改的语法如下</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ALTER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> tbl_name CHANGE <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">COLUMN</span> c1 c1 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">VARCHAR</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">255</span>), ALGORITHM<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span>INPLACE, LOCK<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span>NONE;</pre>
</div>
<p>The number of length bytes required by a VARCHAR column must remain the same. For VARCHAR columns of 0 to 255 bytes in size, one length byte is required to encode the value. For VARCHAR columns of 256 bytes in size or more, two length bytes are required. As a result, in-place ALTER TABLE only supports increasing VARCHAR column size from 0 to 255 bytes, or from 256 bytes to a greater size. In-place ALTER TABLE does not support increasing the size of a VARCHAR column from less than 256 bytes to a size equal to or greater than 256 bytes. In this case, the number of required length bytes changes from 1 to 2, which is only supported by a table copy (ALGORITHM=COPY). For example, attempting to change VARCHAR column size for a single byte character set from VARCHAR(255) to VARCHAR(256) using in-place ALTER TABLE returns this error:</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ALTER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> tbl_name ALGORITHM<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span>INPLACE, CHANGE <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">COLUMN</span> c1 c1 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">VARCHAR</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">256</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
ERROR 0A000: ALGORITHM</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span>INPLACE <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> supported. Reason: Cannot change
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">column</span> type INPLACE. Try ALGORITHM<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span>COPY.</pre>
</div>
<p>注意：The byte length of a <code class="literal">VARCHAR</code> column is dependant on the byte length of the character set.</p>
<p>Decreasing VARCHAR size using in-place ALTER TABLE is not supported. Decreasing VARCHAR size requires a table copy (ALGORITHM=COPY).</p>
<p>---摘自官网：https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/5.7/en/innodb-online-ddl-operations.html#online-ddl-column-operations</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>注意</strong>：在有关Extending VARCHAR column size的说明中 ，官网没有涉及字段Index的内容。很可惜。</p>
<h3>3. 不一样的风景</h3>
<h4>3.1 场景</h4>
<p>不知读者是否已遇到或者注意到，给表的字段扩展长度有时候很快，而有时候有需要消耗几分钟。排除掉官网提到的字段长度encode临界值的修改---字节256，还是解释不了为什么会执行那么久。</p>
<p>按照官网的说明，在相同的encode字节要求下（1--255；256及以上），&nbsp;&nbsp;这个操作只是修改了元数据，不需要Rebuilds Table，应该瞬间完成（或者说3S内）。那么执行了几分钟，是不是很有些因素是官网没有提到的。</p>
<h4>3.2 举例说明</h4>
<table border="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>MySQL版本</td>
<td>5.7.21</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Server配置</td>
<td>8核24G；VSAN盘</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>表--qq_order_cust</td>
<td>
<p>记录数：760W</p>
<p>Data length：2.8G</p>
<p>Index length：1.5G</p>
<p>Table Size：4.3G&nbsp;</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>修改的列</td>
<td>
<p>列1：product_name VARCHAR(64)</p>
<p>列1：per_type VARCHAR(16)</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>table collation</td>
<td>utf8mb4_general_ci</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>SQL语句1</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ALTER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> qq_order_cust ALGORITHM<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span>INPLACE, CHANGE <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">COLUMN</span> product_name product_name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">VARCHAR</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">128</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>product_name列的长度由64调整到128，&nbsp; 这条语句执行了247S，4分钟。--<strong>这个情况是用官网知识解释不了的，不符合预期。</strong></p>
<p>SQL语句2</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ALTER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> qq_order_cust ALGORITHM<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span>INPLACE, CHANGE <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">COLUMN</span> per_type per_type <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">VARCHAR</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">32</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>per_type列的长度由16调整到32，这条语句 瞬间完成，不到1S。<strong>---符合预期</strong></p>
<p>有同学可能会认为会不会数据已缓存到内存中了，所以SQL语句2执行快了很多。这个我们排除掉了。--我们执行了语句3--将product_name 由128调整到132--，还是执行240多秒，所以，语句2执行快很快和数据内存无关。</p>
<p>按照官网的知识，上面两个语句都是应该瞬间执行完成的。</p>
<p>这是怎么回事？难道是随机的？这以后怎么评估执行时间和影响呢？</p>
<h4>3.3 灵光乍现</h4>
<p>反复比较，盯着表创建语句看了N遍，忽然发现 耗时久的那个字段上有index，是两个独立的索引Index，即这个字段和其它不同的字段分别组合了Composite Index。</p>
<p>难道耗时久，和index有关。</p>
<p>抱着尝试的心态，我们决定试下。</p>
<p>因为是验证环境，保存语句，然后，我们直接将这两个有关 product_name 的index直接删除掉了。</p>
<p>再执行&nbsp;SQL4&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ALTER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> qq_order_cust ALGORITHM<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span>INPLACE, CHANGE <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">COLUMN</span> product_name product_name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">VARCHAR</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">132</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>长度由128调整到132，这次瞬间完成了，不到1S。<strong>---符合预期</strong></p>
<p>惊喜，那就再验证一次</p>
<p>SQL5</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ALTER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> qq_order_cust ALGORITHM<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span>INPLACE, CHANGE <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">COLUMN</span> product_name product_name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">VARCHAR</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">156</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>这是还是瞬间完成。<strong>---符合预期</strong></p>
<p>基于以上的验证，可以得出以下结论</p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>结论： 修改有索引的字段的长度，不会瞬间完成，不是Only Modifies Metadata 。<em>这是官网上没提到的。</em></strong></span></p>
<h4>3.4 继续探究</h4>
<p>实验尚未。刚才说了，在两个关联索引的条件下耗时247S，如果只有一个关联index，不会快些。【注意：所谓的关联index，是指和指定字段有关联，和要修改的字段有关联】</p>
<p>我们想到这一点，已经欣欣然了，忍不住继续测试下去。</p>
<p>先仅修复其中一个index。在此条件下执行SQL6</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ALTER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> qq_order_cust ALGORITHM<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span>INPLACE, CHANGE <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">COLUMN</span> product_name product_name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">VARCHAR</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">186</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>SQL耗时变成了131S。耗时是原来的一半左右。---<strong>---符合预期，小小激动。</strong></p>
<p>继续修复第二个关联index，执行SQL7</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ALTER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> qq_order_cust ALGORITHM<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span>INPLACE, CHANGE <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">COLUMN</span> product_name product_name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">VARCHAR</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">258</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>此时，SQL耗时变成了242S。</p>
<p>基于以上的验证，可以得出以下结论</p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>结论：修改有索引的字段的长度，其耗时 和 这个字段上索引的个数正相关；索引越多，耗时越久。<em>这是官网上没提到的。</em></strong></span></p>
<h3>4. 总结</h3>
<p>1. Extending VARCHAR column size，字段的字节长度（255--&gt;256）是个临界值。注意是字节，如果选用的字符集是utf8mb4，VARCHAR字段对应的VARCHAR(63)--&gt;VARCHAR(64)是临界值。这点官网上有提到。</p>
<p><strong>2.修改有索引的字段的长度，不会瞬间完成，不是Only Modifies Metadata。这是官网上没提到的。</strong></p>
<p><strong>3.修改有索引的字段的长度，其耗时 和 这个字段上索引的个数正相关；索引越多，耗时越久。这是官网上没提到的。</strong></p>
<p><strong>4. 官网中 字段长度扩展不Rebuilds Table、Only Modifies Metadata，这儿应该有个特指--仅指的是<span class="qk-md-strong complete">聚簇索引（Clustered Index），</span>不包含辅助index（<span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i4.39f22988AKuuSq">也被称为<span class="qk-md-strong complete">二级索引<span class="qk-md-text complete">或<span class="qk-md-strong complete">非聚簇索引</span></span></span></span>）。因为案例中的4分钟，应该是在重整字段相关的辅助ndex，通过监控也可以看到4分钟内有大量的IO操作。<strong>这是官网上没提到的。</strong></strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>备注</strong></p>
<p>1.此测试是在MySQL 5.7.21 版本下验证的，MySQL8.0 版本下是什么表现，尚未验证。</p>
<p>2.本次字段扩展实验用的是utf8mb4字符集下VARCHAR类型。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
